When a user is trying to log in on citrix through browser.

This error code comes through after login and verification.

"Cannot complete your request"

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Before all other troubleshooting, clear the cache and cookies to prompt a new re-login.

Use the username **domain\username**

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Another error when trying to log in could be the following

![](data:image/png;base64,)

For starters, the username in the example is wrong. It should be **name.lastname@** when logging into the citrix app.

If they are 100% sure the password is correct, it could be an MFA issue. Citrix will not tell/prompt you this is the issue, so resetting the MFA or setting it up is something to try.
